x-e-e2-05.thinking.0: Odeeffannoon gahaa moo hin gahne murteessuu
x-e-e2-05.topic: Mallattoo yeroo, iddoo fi namoota irratti
x-e-e2-05.title: 'Two tickets, please.' eessa? Odeeffannoon gahaa moo hin taane murteessuu
x-e-e2-05.goal: Sararoota dhaga'aman lamaan qofaan iddoo murteessuu danda'amaa moo hin danda'amu murteessi, akkasumas mallattoo dabalataa iddoowwan addaan baasu filadhu.
x-e-e2-05.material:
Dhiira tokko fi qaama tikeetii gurguru dhageesse. Eessa akka ta'e hin jenne.

Man: Two tickets, please.
Clerk: Here you are. The show starts at 7:00.
x-e-e2-05.thinking.1: Iddoowwan filatamoo baay'ee wal bira qabuu
x-e-e2-05.prereq.0: Jechoota salphaa akka ticket, show, movie, popcorn
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.prompt: Sararoota lamaan kana qofaan iddoo tokko murteessuu dandeessaa?
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Iddoowwan sararoonni lamaan kunniin itti jedhamuu danda'an lama ykn sadii yaadi.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Iddoon filannoo tokko tokkoon maqaa baasu sararoota lamaan wajjin walsimaa yaadi.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.o.a: Murteessuu hin dandeenyu. Iddoon baay'ee ni danda'ama, akka sinamaa ykn galma muuziqaa
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.r.a: 'Show' fi tikeetiin iddoowwan baay'ee irratti fayyadamuu danda'u.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.o.b: Sinamaa dha. Sababni isaas tikeetiin dhufe
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.r.b: Tikeetiin iddoowwan sinamaa alaa illee, akka galma muuziqaa, buufata bineensaa, ykn buufata baabura, irratti dhufa.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.o.c: Buufata baabura dha. Sababni isaas 7:00 irratti ka'a
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.r.c: Baaburri yeroo baay'ee 'train' jedhama, 'show' miti. Ragaan isaa dadhabaa dha.
x-e-e2-05.s.s1.explain: Tikeetii fi show jechoota iddoowwan baay'ee, akka sinamaa ykn galma muuziqaa, irratti fayyadaman dha. Sararoota lamaan qofaa irraa tokko murteessuun ulfaataa dha.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.prompt: Sararoota dabalataa iddoon 'sinamaa' moo 'galma muuziqaa' ta'uu isaa addaan baasan hunda filadhu.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Sarara tokko tokkoo sinamaa fi galma muuziqaa lamaanuu keessa galchiitii, sarara lamaanuu wajjin walsimu tokko balleessi.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sararoonni hafan tokkicha qofa wajjin caalaatti walsimuu isaanii mirkaneessi.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.a: Popcorn nyaata sinamaa irratti yeroo baay'ee bitamu dha. Galma muuziqaa irraa isa addaan baasu mallattoo ta'uu danda'a.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.b: Sinamaa fi galma muuziqaa lamaanuu sararoota teessuma qabu. Jechoonni kunniin lamaan addaan hin baasan.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.c: Screen (agarsiisaa) sinamaa irratti galma muuziqaa caalaa jecha barbaachisaa dha. Lamaan addaan baasu mallattoo ta'uu danda'a.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.r.d: Callisuuf himamuun iddoo lamaan irrattiyyuu dhaga'amuu danda'a.
x-e-e2-05.s.s2.explain: Jechoonni filatamoo lamaanuu wajjin walsimani (sararoota teessuma, callisuu) iddoowwan hin addaan baasan. Popcorn fi screen mallattoo sinamaa dhiyoo dha. Garuu sarara tokkoon guutummaatti murteessuun ulfaataa ta'uu danda'a.

x-e-e2-07.title: Nagaa barsiisaa wajjin kamtu walsima? Daangaa ulaagaa yaaduu
x-e-e2-07.goal: Deebii nagaa barsiisaa wajjin walsimu filadhuutii, yeroo yaadni 'ulaagaa qabaachuun yeroo hundaa caala' jedhu hin dhugoomne tokko himi.
x-e-e2-07.material:
Barsiisaan ganama "How are you today, Mina?" jedha.

Hiriyaan kee Jin: "Afaan Ingilizii keessatti ulaagaadhaan dubbachuun yeroo hundaa caala. Nama hundumaatti akkasuma dubbachuu dandeessa" jedhe.
x-e-e2-07.thinking.0: Nama biraa irratti hundaa'uun deebii filachuu
x-e-e2-07.thinking.1: Haala yaadni itti hin dhugoomne (fakkeenya faallaa) argachuu
x-e-e2-07.prereq.0: Nagaa bu'uuraa akka How are you? fi I'm fine.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.prompt: Deebii gaafii barsiisaa wajjin walsimu hunda filadhu.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.hint.0: Deebiin gaafii wajjin walsimaa fi barsiisaaf mijataa dha addaan mirkaneessi.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.hint.1: Deebii hiika wal-fakkaatu qabu keessatti illee kan salphaa fi kan ulaagaa addaan baasi.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.r.a: Sagalee salphaa hiriyoota gidduu fayyadamu dha. Barsiisaaf hin mijatu.

x-e-e2-07.s.s1.r.c: Deebise garuu qabbanaa'aa dha, kanaaf nagaa barsiisaa wajjin hin walsimu.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.r.d: Salphaa dha, garuu galata fi And you? jira, kanaaf deebii barsiisaaf illee gaarii dha.
x-e-e2-07.s.s1.explain: b fi d nagaa deebisu fi nama biraa deebi'anii gaafatu, kanaaf barsiisaaf ni mijatu. a baay'ee salphaa dha, c immoo hamaa dhaga'ama.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.prompt: Yeroo dubbiin Jin "ulaagaadhaan dubbachuun yeroo hundaa caala" hin dhugoomne fakkeenya tokko barreessi. (Afaan Ingilizii ykn Afaan Koreyaa lamaanuu ni danda'a)
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.hint.0: Nama ykn haala jechoota ulaagaa fayyadamuun dhaga'amuu hin mijanne tokko yaadi.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nama sana wajjin jechoota ulaagaa fayyadamuun akkamitti akka dhaga'amu barreessi.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Fakkeenya kee keessatti maaliif jechoonni ulfina hin mijaa'ine jettee jirta?
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Fakkeenyi 'yeroo hundaa' jedhu cabsu yoo xiqqaate tokko jiraa?
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.model.0: Hiriyaa dhiyoo "I would be delighted to" jechuun baay'ee jabaa fi ajaa'iba dha.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Haala hiriyaa waliin itti dubbatan fakkeenya godhee kenne.
x-e-e2-07.s.s2.model.3: Saree xiqqoo waliin afaan ulfina fayyadamuun ajaa'iba dha.

Sun Park

No bikes.
Dogs OK.

Hiriyyaan kee Tom, "I will go to Sun Park with my dog and my bike at 7 p.m.!" jedhe.

x-e-e2-01.thinking.2: Rakkoo fi wanta rakkoo hin taane adda baasuu

x-e-e2-01.s.s1.r.c: a.m./p.m. lakkoofsa sarara Open bira jiru yeroo Tom waliin wal bira qabi. Kutaan kun illee wal faallessa, kanaaf kutaa wal-simatu miti.

x-e-e2-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Saree eeyyamamuu akka hin makne of eegdeettaa? (filannoo)
x-e-e2-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Deebii gaarii yeroo biraa illee yaadu.

x-e-e2-03.title: Max eenyu? Akka mallattoon dabalutti yaada jijjiiruu
x-e-e2-03.topic: Mallattoo yeroo, iddoo fi namoota irratti
x-e-e2-03.goal: Marii sarara tokko tokkoon irra deebi'ii dubbisiitii 'Max eenyu' jedhu irratti tilmaama kee jijjiiri, akkasumas mallattoo haaraa ofiin barreessi.
x-e-e2-03.material: Sararoonni paarkii keessatti dhaga'aman sarara tokko tokkoon ni mul'atu. Max seenaa keessa jiru eenyu akka ta'e yaadi.
x-e-e2-03.thinking.0: Yeroo mallattoon haaraan mul'atu hundaa irra deebi'ii murteessi
x-e-e2-03.thinking.1: Tilmaamni kee jalqabaa dogoggora ta'uu akka danda'u fudhadhu
x-e-e2-03.thinking.2: Sarara akka mallattootti hojjetu ofiin tolchi
x-e-e2-03.prereq.0: Jechoota salphaa akka Come here, Sit, Thank you
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarara tokko tokkoon dubbisiitii 'Max eenyu ta'uu danda'a?' jedhu irratti yaada ofii murteessi. Mallattoon yeroo dabalu yaadni kee jijjiiramuu danda'a.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tilmaamni kee sararoota hanga ammaa hunda wajjin walsimaa mirkaneessi.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.hint.1: Dura sarara haaraan tilmaama kee duraa wajjin walsimaa wal bira qabi.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.info: Sarara jalqabaa: "Come here, Max! Good boy!"
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Mallattoo hanga ammaa irratti hundaa'ee tilmaama sababa qabu tokko filadhu. (Deebii sababa qabu lama ta'uu danda'u.)
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mallattoo hanga ammaa irratti hundaa'ee tilmaama sababa qabu tokko filadhu. (Deebii sababa qabu lama ta'uu danda'u.)
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Sarara tokko irraa, saree ykn daa'ima lamaan keessaa tokko ta'uu danda'a. Mallattoon tokko murteessuuf gahaa miti.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Good boy' saree ykn daa'imaaf jechuun ni danda'ama. Sarara tokkoon murteessuu hin danda'amu, garuu saree jedhamuun sababa qaba.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Jechoonni kunniin daa'immaniifis ni fayyadamu. Sarara tokkoon saree irraa addaan baasuun hin danda'amu.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: "Good boy" yeroo baay'ee nama guddaaf hin jedhamu. Daa'ima xiqqaa ykn bineensaaf jedhama.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Sarara lammaffaa: "Sit! Take the ball, Max! Run!"
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.after: 'Sit!' fi kubbaan taphachuu irraa saree ta'uun caalaatti sababa qaba. Carraan daa'ima ta'uu guutummaatti hin badne.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Daa'imni taphaa keessatti kubbaa qabuu ni danda'a. Ni danda'ama, garuu 'Sit!' wajjin yoo ilaalamu saree ta'uun caalaatti uumamaa dha.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: "Sit!" fi kubbaa qabuun yeroo baay'ee nama guddaaf hin jedhamu.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 'Sit!' fi kubbaa darbachuun taphoota namoonni sareedhaan yeroo baay'ee taphatan dha.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Sarara sadaffaa: Max ni dubbata. "Thank you, Dad! I like this game."
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hanga sarara kanaatti erga dubbistee booda, Max eenyu ta'uu isaa caalaatti?
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Max kan dubbatu Abbaa galateeffata, kanaaf Max daa'ima dha. Taphni 'Sit!' duraa taphaa daa'ima wajjin taphatamu ta'ee ilaalamuu danda'a.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Saree 'Thank you, Dad!' jechuu hin dandeessu. Sararri kun tilmaama duraa wajjin hin walsimu.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Max Abbaa wajjin dubbatu nama guddaa ta'uu isaa kan agarsiisu mallattoo hin jiru. "Good boy" fi taphaa taphachuu wajjin yoo ilaalamu, daa'ima ta'uun nama guddaa ta'uu caalaa uumamaa dha.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Inni Abbaa wajjin dubbata, taphni isaa akka isaaf mi'aawu ni jedha, kanaaf taphni duraa illee ni ibsama.
x-e-e2-03.s.s1.reflect: Jalqaba saree jettee tilmaamte illee, mallattoo haaraa (Max ni dubbata) akkaataa isaatiin yaada kee jijjiiruun sababa qaba. Tilmaamni sarara tokkoo irraa murtaa'e mallattoo haaraa duratti jijjiiramuu danda'a.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.prompt: Marii haaraa keessatti, Max 'saree' ta'uu isaa ifa akka ta'u barbaaddu. Sarara Afaan Ingilizii Max kan of keessaa qabu tokko barreessi.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.hint.0: Wantoota sareedhaan hojjetaman ykn sagalee saree baasu yaadi.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.hint.1: Maqaa Max fi mallattoo sana hima tokko keessatti walitti qabi.
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Jechi sarara koo keessa jiru kam saree ta'uu isaa agarsiisa?
x-e-e2-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Jechi sun daa'imaaf illee fayyadamuu ni danda'aa?

x-e-e2-04.topic: Mallattoo yeroo, iddoo fi namoota irratti
x-e-e2-04.title: Mallattoo gabatee jiimii fayyadamuun yeroo jalqabaa daqiiqaa 30 jiimii argachuu
x-e-e2-04.goal: Mallattoo yeroo banuu fi yeroo qulqulleessuu qabu irraa, yeroo jalqabaa daqiiqaa 30 jiimii guutummaatti danda'amu baay'ee argadhu.
x-e-e2-04.material:
Mallattoon jiimii (jechaan qofa barreeffame, fakkii malee):

City Pool
Open: 2:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m.
Closed for cleaning: 3:00 - 3:30 p.m.
One swim: 30 minutes

Isaa fi hiriyaan kee ooftuu guyyaa keessa altokko daqiiqaa 30 osoo hin dhaabbatin jiimii barbaaddu. Jiimiin osoo hin xumuramin dura bishaan jiimii cufamuu hin qabu.

x-e-e2-06.title: 'Give me your pen.' barsiisaa fi hiriyaaf adda addaatti jechuu
x-e-e2-06.goal: Gaaffii wal-fakkaatu hima Afaan Ingilizii lamaatti irra deebi'ii barreessi, tokkoon tokkoon isaa dhaggeeffataa (barsiisaa/hiriyaa) wajjin walsimu.
x-e-e2-06.material: Peenii si barbaachisa. Hima jalqabaa "Give me your pen." dha. Yoo dhaggeeffataan barsiisaa ta'e, kun gabaabaa fi hamaa ta'ee dhaga'amuu danda'a. Altokko barsiisaadhaaf, altokko hiriyaa dhiyoo ta'eef, altokko lama irra deebi'ii barreessi.
x-e-e2-06.thinking.1: Jechoota ulaagaa fi jechoota hiriyummaa addaan baasuu
x-e-e2-06.prereq.0: Jechoota gaafii salphaa akka please, Can I ~?, Could I ~?
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.prompt: Barsiisaa kee ulaagaadhaan peenii siif waliigaltu gaafadhu. (hima Afaan Ingilizii tokko)
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.hint.0: Yeroo gaafii taasistu jechoota akka 'Could I ~?' fayyadamu yaadi.
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.hint.1: Excuse me ykn please yoo dabalte sagaleen akkamitti akka jijjiiramu yaadi.
x-e-e2-06.s.s1.selfAssess.1: Jechoota gaafii (Could I, May I, please) kan of keessaa qabu jiraa?
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.prompt: Al kana, hiriyaa kutaa dhiyoo peenii siif waliigaltu salphaatti gaafadhu. (hima Afaan Ingilizii tokko)
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.hint.0: Jechoota barsiisaaf barreessite keessaa hiriyaaf cimaa ta'e tokko baasi.
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.hint.1: Jecha nagaa ykn gaafii gabaabaa hiriyoonni salphaatti fayyadaman galchi.
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Hiriyaaf mijataa dha jedhamee dhaga'amuu danda'aa?
x-e-e2-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Hima barsiisaaf barreessite irraa maaliin adda?

x-e-e2-08.title: Hima seenaa Coco waliin hin mijaa'in argadhii sirreessi
x-e-e2-08.goal: Hima shan keessaa, ragaa isa duraa fi booda jiruun kan faallaa ta'e argadhii, hima seenaa waliin mijaa'u godhii irra deebi'ii barreessi.
x-e-e2-08.material: Armaan gadii barreeffama gabaabaa saree Coco beeksisu dha. Hima tokko hima barreeffama keessa jiran kan biraa waliin hin mijaa'u.
x-e-e2-08.thinking.0: Hima wal bira qabuudhaan faallaa argachuu
x-e-e2-08.prereq.0: Ibsa maqaa salphaa akka guddaa, xiqqaa, bunni, adii
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.prompt: Hima barreeffama keessa jiran kan biraa waliin hin mijaa'in filadhu.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.hint.0: Sararoota bifa Coco ibsan adda walitti qabii wal bira qabi.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.hint.1: Yoo sararoonni tokko tokko wal-faallessan, gama sararoota baay'ee deeggaran amani.
x-e-e2-08.s.s1.explain: Sararri 2 fi 3 Coco baay'ee xiqqoo dha jedhu. Sararri 4 Coco guddaa fi bunni dha jedha, kanaaf lamaan sana waliin wal-faallessa. Sararri 1 fi 5 seenaa Coco waliin ni mijaa'u.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.prompt: Hima sana seenaa Coco waliin akka mijaa'uuf Afaan Ingiliiziitiin irra deebi'ii barreessi.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.hint.0: Dhugaa Coco ilaalchisee duraan hin dubbatamne tokko yaadi.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.hint.1: Hima gabaabaa She ykn Coco jedhuun jalqabu barreessi.
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Hiriyaa itti hima haaraan himoota isa duraa waliin akka hin wal-faallesne mirkaneessiteettaa?
x-e-e2-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Odeeffannoo haaraa Coco ilaalchisee ni kenna.

x-e-e2-09.title: Hima barreeffama muduraa keessatti hin mijaa'in hojjedhii hiriyaa'f akka tooftaa kenni
x-e-e2-09.goal: Himni maal akka hin mijaa'ne mata-dureen murteessuu isaa hubadhu, mata-duree tokko fi hima isa waliin hin mijaa'in tokko hojjedhu.
x-e-e2-09.material:
Hiriyaa'f kennuuf tooftaa 'isa adda ta'e filadhu' hojjetta. Duraan fakkeenya tokko haa ilaallu.

I like apples. I like bananas. Grapes are sweet. ?
x-e-e2-09.prereq.0: Himoota salphaa akka I like ~. fi ~ is/are ...
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.prompt: Hima afraffaa ta'ee kam hin mijaa'u? (Mata-duree: muduraa)
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.0: Mata-duree himoota sadan jalqabaa waliin qaban jecha tokkoon dubbadhu.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.hint.1: Himni tokko mata-duree sana keessa hin seenne jiraachuu isaa mirkaneessi.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.a: Peach muduraa dha, kanaaf mata-duree waliin ni mijaa'a.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.b: Orange illee muduraa dha, kanaaf ni mijaa'a.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.r.c: Carrot muduraa miti. Mata-dureen 'muduraa' ta'ee yeroo ilaalamu, hin mijaa'u.
x-e-e2-09.s.s1.explain: Himoonni sadan jalqabaa hundi muduraa ilaalchisu (apples, bananas, grapes). Carrot kuduraa dha, kanaaf mata-duree waliin hin mijaa'u. Yoo mata-duree gara 'nyaata' babal'iste, carrot illee ni mijaa'uu danda'a. Mijaa'uu isaa mata-duree ati murteessitu irratti hundaa'a.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.prompt: Tooftaa hiriyaa'f kennuuf hojjedhu. (1) Himoota Afaan Ingiliizii sadan mata-duree tokko waliin mijaa'an, (2) hima tokko hin mijaa'in (isa afraffaa), (3) deebii dhuma irratti barreessi, akka "Odd one: 4."
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.0: Mata-duree tokko (bineensota, mana barumsaa, nyaata, kkf) murteessi, duraan mata-duree sanaaf himoota sadii barreessi.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.hint.1: Hima mata-duree adda ta'e isa afraffaa godhii barreessi, 'Odd one: 4.' dabali.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mata-dureen himoota sadan jalqabaa ifatti tokko qofa?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Himni afraffaan mata-duree adda ta'e irratti garuu bifaan wal-fakkaataa dha?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Hiriyaan kee yeroo furtu, deebii argachuuf agarsiistuu kamiin fayyadama?
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.0: Haasaan nyaata ilaalchisu seenaa adurree keessa makame.
x-e-e2-09.s.s2.modelNote.1: Himni tiigarii ilaalchisu seenaa mana barumsaa keessa makame.

x-e-e2-10.title: Ergaa barreeffamaa keessatti odeeffannoo dhabame argu gaaffii tokko hojjedhu
x-e-e2-10.goal: Odeeffannoo ergaa keessa hin jirre argadhu, gaaffii bu'a-qabeessa isa tokko filadhu, akkasumas haala haaraa keessatti gaaffii ofii hojjedhu.
x-e-e2-10.material:
Hiriyaan kee Sora barreeffama erge.

"Let's play tomorrow! Bring a ball."

Deemuu barbaadda, garuu wantoota muraasa hin beekne.
x-e-e2-10.prereq.0: Jechoota gaaffii akka When, Where, What time
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.prompt: Gaaffii bu'a-qabeessa isa tokko Sora'f gaafatamu filadhu.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ergaa kolonii lamatti qoodi: wanta duraan siif himu fi wanta ammayyuu hin beekne.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Wal arguuf maal beekuu akka qabdu yaadi.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.a: Gaaffiin kun odeeffannoo lama yeroo tokkotti gaafata: bakka fi yeroo, lamaanuu wal arguuf barbaachisaa dha.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.b: Ergaan duraanuu kubbaa fidi jedha. Gosa kubbaa beekuun gaarii ta'a, garuu odeeffannoo barbaachisu kan biraa hin kennu.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.c: Bakka beekuu dandeessa, garuu yeroo ammayyuu hin beekne. Wanti tokko qofa furameera.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.r.d: Sora kubbaa jaallachuun odeeffannoo wal arguuf barbaachisu miti.
x-e-e2-10.s.s1.explain: Ergaan "tomorrow" fi "bring a ball" qofa qaba, bakka fi yeroo hin qabu. Gaaffiin odeeffannoo lama yeroo tokkotti gaafatu isa bu'a-qabeessa dha. Gaaffiin bakka qofa gaafatu yeroo hin beekamne dhiisa, gaaffiin gosa kubbaa ykn fedhii Sora ilaalchisu odeeffannoo wal arguuf barbaachisu miti.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.prompt: Haala haaraa dha. Abbaan: "We'll go on a trip on Saturday." jedhe. Odeeffannoo dhabame isa barbaachisaa ta'e argachuuf gaaffii Afaan Ingiliizii tokko barreessi. (Mallattoo gaaffii tokko qofa fayyadami)
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.0: Wanta jecha Abbaa irraa duraanuu beektu (Saturday, trip) fi wanta hin beekne adda baasi.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.hint.1: Wantoota hin beekne keessaa tokko filadhii gaaffii Where ykn What time jedhuun jalqabu hojjedhu.
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Gaaffiin koo odeeffannoo jecha Abbaa keessa hin jirre gaafataa?
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Deebiin gaaffii sanaa qophii imalaaf nama gargaara?
x-e-e2-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Waa'ee yeroo gaafachuun illee gaarii dha.
